title: Boolean-based blind SQL injection in product search
description: The `q` parameter of the product search is concatenated into a SQL query, allowing boolean-based blind injection that exfiltrates the users table.

evidence.raw_response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html
12 results
logs: [10:12:42] AND 1=1 -> 12 results, AND 1=2 -> 0 results, injection confirmed
evidence.explanation: The two payloads returned different result sets, confirming injection, then the users table was enumerated character by character.

remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements for all database access.
